subject: Demo follow-up: buying path checklist & intro chain request
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Park <apark@medicorehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-11-03T15:12:00Z
Subject: Demo follow-up: buying path checklist & intro chain request

Hi Alicia —

Thanks again for taking the demo today. Quick recap and three asks so we can keep momentum: 

Recap (2 min):
- Deck review: we walked through a 20-min end-to-end demo of inference latency/cost controls and Dedicated options.
- Outcome: Medicore is interested in a pilot for the Claims Automation workflow; tight latency requirements for batch + realtime enrichment.

Asks (high priority):
1) Can you share the names + emails for the economic buyer and procurement lead for this project? We want to make sure pricing/commit approvals are routed correctly.
2) Who owns security/compliance evidence (SOC2, retention, data flow reviews)? Name and best contact or distribution list is fine.
3) Would you be able to share a simple org chart or stakeholder map (even a bulleted list of owners) so we can tailor the pilot success criteria and contract timeline?

Proposed next steps:
- If you can share those contacts, we’ll loop in Commercial to set a 30-minute procurement intro and Security Q&A.
- I attached the demo recording and a one-pager that summarizes the pilot options.

Optional: If there are any specific decision criteria (latency P95 target, uptime SLA, data residency) that matter, reply with those and I’ll include them in the commercial brief.

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
dylan.brooks@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: demo-recording-20271103.mp4 (video), redwood-onepager-medicore.pdf (one-pager)

From: Alicia Park <apark@medicorehealth.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Janelle Ortiz <janelle.ortiz@medicorehealth.com>, Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@medicorehealth.com>
Date: 2027-11-03T18:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Demo follow-up: buying path checklist & intro chain request

Dylan —

Appreciate the clear recap. Quick answers below while I pull together the org chart.

- Economic buyer: Janelle Ortiz (SVP of Product) — janelle.ortiz@medicorehealth.com. She owns vendor budget for product initiatives.
- Procurement: procurement@medicorehealth.com (primary distribution list); procurement lead is Marcus Liu but the team triages initial vendor conversations.
- Security/Compliance: Tom Ellis (Security Architect) — tom.ellis@medicorehealth.com. He handles SOC2 evidence and data flows.

Decision drivers: performance under 150ms P95 for enrichment calls, clear data retention + deletion controls, and a workable pilot T&Cs timeline (30–60 days).

I can put together a 1-page stakeholder list and a quick org chart by EOD Friday — will also include who needs to sign.

A couple questions for you:
- Can you share a short procurement timeline template or mutual action plan we can use?
- Any precedent for a two-month pilot with limited seats + data residency options?

Thanks —
Alicia Park
Director, Clinical Integrations
Medicore Health

Great — thanks for the fast responses, Alicia.

I’ve done two quick things:
- Drafted a one-page mutual action plan template (link below) we use to align procurement/security timelines. I can pre-fill it once you share the org chart.
- Proposed three 30-minute windows for a commercial + procurement intro this week: Thurs 11/04 10:00–10:30 PT, Fri 11/05 09:00–09:30 PT, Fri 11/05 14:00–14:30 PT. Pick what works and I’ll send a calendar invite.

Links: https://hubspot.redwood.ai/deal/RDW-2027-MED-58 (internal deal)
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-demo-materials

If Janelle prefers a short exec summary instead of the full deck, Marissa (cc’d) can draft it and include pricing options for a 2-month pilot. Ben can cover technical fit if Tom wants to test a sample payload.

Would you be able to share the org chart by EOD tomorrow? Even a simple list of who reviews and who signs will help route things correctly.

Thanks,
Dylan
